T2M.label: Air temperature
T2M.definition: Temperature of the air 2 m above the ground.

PRECTOTCORR.label: Rainfall (model)
PRECTOTCORR.definition: Rain and snow, from the MERRA-2 model corrected with rain gauges.

RH2M.label: Humidity
RH2M.definition: How close the air is to holding all the water vapour it can.

GWETTOP.label: Topsoil wetness
GWETTOP.definition: How wet the top layer of soil is: 0 = bone dry, 1 = soaked.

soil_moisture.label: Soil moisture
soil_moisture.definition: Water held in the top 10 cm of soil (1 kg/m² ≈ 1 mm of water).

evaporation.label: Evaporation
evaporation.definition: Water leaving the land and plants into the air.

runoff.label: Runoff
runoff.definition: Rainwater flowing off the surface towards rivers.

gpm_rain.label: Rainfall (satellite)
gpm_rain.definition: Rain measured by the Global Precipitation Measurement satellites.

aerosol.label: Haze
aerosol.definition: How much dust, smoke, pollution and sea salt dims sunlight. 0 = perfectly clear.

dust.label: Desert dust
dust.definition: The part of the haze made of desert dust.

T2M_MAX.label: Hottest temperature of the month
T2M_MAX.definition: The highest air temperature reached in each month.

T2M_MIN.label: Coldest temperature of the month
T2M_MIN.definition: The lowest air temperature reached in each month (usually at night).

QV2M.label: Water vapour
QV2M.definition: How much water vapour is in the air: grams of water per kilogram of air.

GWETROOT.label: Root-zone soil wetness
GWETROOT.definition: How wet the soil is where plant roots grow (top metre): 0 = bone dry, 1 = soaked.

ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN.label: Sunshine (solar energy)
ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN.definition: Sunlight reaching the ground, including cloudy days. Higher = more solar power.

WS50M.label: Wind speed at 50 m
WS50M.definition: Average wind speed at wind-turbine height.

soil_moisture.source: GLDAS Noah 2.1, nearest analysed site: London (262 km)

evaporation.source: GLDAS Noah 2.1, nearest analysed site: London (262 km)

runoff.source: GLDAS Noah 2.1, nearest analysed site: London (262 km)

gpm_rain.source: GPM IMERG V07, nearest analysed site: London (262 km)

aerosol.source: MERRA-2 aerosol (M2TMNXAER), nearest analysed site: London (262 km)

dust.source: MERRA-2 aerosol (M2TMNXAER), nearest analysed site: London (262 km)
